name: Get WARP Connector HA configuration
description: Get WARP Connector HA configuration Gets the high-availability configuration for a WARP Connector tunnel. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/warp_connector/{tunnel_id}/configurations
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/warp_connector/{tunnel_id}/configurations
Gets the high-availability configuration for a WARP Connector tunnel.
Required: account_id (path); tunnel_id (path)

name: Update WARP Connector HA configuration
description: Update WARP Connector HA configuration Adds or updates the high-availability configuration for a WARP Connector tunnel. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/warp_connector/{tunnel_id}/configurations
context:
PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/warp_connector/{tunnel_id}/configurations
Adds or updates the high-availability configuration for a WARP Connector tunnel.
Required: account_id (path); tunnel_id (path); body (body)

name: Create a Warp Connector Tunnel
description: Create a Warp Connector Tunnel Creates a new Warp Connector Tunnel in an account. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/warp_connector
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/warp_connector
Creates a new Warp Connector Tunnel in an account.
Required: account_id (path); body (body)

name: Delete a Warp Connector Tunnel
description: Delete a Warp Connector Tunnel Deletes a Warp Connector Tunnel from an account. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/warp_connector/{tunnel_id}

name: Get a Warp Connector Tunnel
description: Get a Warp Connector Tunnel Fetches a single Warp Connector Tunnel. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/warp_connector/{tunnel_id}

name: Get a Warp Connector Tunnel token
description: Get a Warp Connector Tunnel token Gets the token used to associate warp device with a specific Warp Connector tunnel. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/warp_connector/{tunnel_id}/token
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/warp_connector/{tunnel_id}/token
Gets the token used to associate warp device with a specific Warp Connector tunnel.
Required: account_id (path); tunnel_id (path)

name: Get WARP Connector Tunnel connector
description: Get WARP Connector Tunnel connector Fetches connector and connection details for a WARP Connector Tunnel. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/warp_connector/{tunnel_id}/connectors/{connector_id}

name: List WARP Connector Tunnel connections
description: List WARP Connector Tunnel connections Fetches connection details for a WARP Connector Tunnel. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/warp_connector/{tunnel_id}/connections
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/warp_connector/{tunnel_id}/connections
Fetches connection details for a WARP Connector Tunnel.
Required: account_id (path); tunnel_id (path)

name: List Warp Connector Tunnels
description: List Warp Connector Tunnels Lists and filters Warp Connector Tunnels in an account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/warp_connector
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/warp_connector
Lists and filters Warp Connector Tunnels in an account.
Required: account_id (path)
Optional: name (query); is_deleted (query); existed_at (query); uuid (query); was_active_at (query); was_inactive_at (query); include_prefix (query); exclude_prefix (query); status (query); per_page (query); page (query)

name: Trigger a manual failover for a WARP Connector Tunnel
description: Trigger a manual failover for a WARP Connector Tunnel Triggers a manual failover for a specific WARP Connector Tunnel, setting the specified client as the active connector. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/warp_connector/{tunnel_id}/failover
context:
PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/warp_connector/{tunnel_id}/failover
Triggers a manual failover for a specific WARP Connector Tunnel, setting the specified client as the active connector. The tunnel must be configured for high availability (HA) and the client must be linked to the tunnel.
Required: account_id (path); tunnel_id (path); body (body)

name: Update a Warp Connector Tunnel
description: Update a Warp Connector Tunnel Updates an existing Warp Connector Tunnel. PATCH /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/warp_connector/{tunnel_id}
